title: Music Disk CD Recipe
description: Makes music disks craftable by using the (extremely simplified) way of crafting real CDs.
body:
Makes music disks craftable by using the (extremely simplified) way of crafting real CDs.

Intended for use with the [Audioplayer](https://modrinth.com/mod/audioplayer) mod, however it functions just fine without it.

Currently only Strad is craftable, however I hope to make every music disk craftable and add compatibility with the [Blank Discs](https://modrinth.com/mod/blank-discs) mod in the future.

This was made because of a bit, so it's tedious on purpose. I did still try to avoid making it _too_ annoying though.
